knowledge:
- key_parameters: numClusters=The number of clusters to use in the underlying k-means algorithm during normalization (advised to choose by analyzing the data distribution) ;; comparison=A character vector of length 2 specifying the groups to compare in the differential analysis (e.g., c("HSMM", "HESC")) ;; sampleDir=The directory path where the raw BAM files specified in the sample info file are located ;; inputCountData=The file path to a tab-separated raw count data file if bypassing read counting ;; noNeg=Logical indicating whether to prevent negative values during preprocessing ;; plotData=Logical indicating whether to plot the data distribution before and after transformation
- alternatives: None mentioned in the documentation.
- when_to_use: Use this package when performing differential binding analysis on ChIP-seq datasets, especially when dealing with varying signal-to-noise ratios, paired control (input) experiments, and a small number of replicates (e.g., 2 or fewer replicates per group).
- pitfalls: Bypassing background correction when using pre-calculated counts via loadCountData, which directly proceeds to transformation and normalization ;; Choosing an inappropriate numClusters parameter without first inspecting the data distribution.

workflows.name: differential_binding_from_bams
workflows.intent: Identify differentially bound regions step-by-step starting from raw BAM files and a BED file of regions of interest.
input: chr19_regions.bed (BED file containing the genomic regions of interest)
sample_info.txt (Tab-separated text file containing sample metadata, group assignments, and BAM file names)
BAM files (ChIP-seq IP and Input control BAM files located in the sample directory)
workflows.stages: 1. Quantify reads in regions of interest and perform background correction using getRegionCounts ;; 2. Apply Anscombe transformation using ansTransform ;; 3. Normalize transformed counts across samples using normalizeData ;; 4. Perform non-parametric statistical testing for differential binding using DBAnalyze
workflows.code:
regionBed <- read.table(system.file("extdata", "chr19_regions.bed", package="CSSQ",mustWork = TRUE))
sampleInfo <- read.table(system.file("extdata", "sample_info.txt", package="CSSQ",mustWork = TRUE),sep="\t",header=TRUE)
countData <- getRegionCounts(system.file("extdata", "chr19_regions.bed", package="CSSQ"),sampleInfo,sampleDir = system.file("extdata", package="CSSQ"))
ansCountData <- ansTransform(countData)
normInfo <- normalizeData(ansCountData,numClusters=4)
result <- DBAnalyze(normInfo,comparison=c("HSMM","HESC"))

workflows.name: differential_binding_from_precalculated_counts
workflows.intent: Identify differentially bound regions step-by-step starting from a pre-calculated tab-separated count matrix.
input: sample_count_data.txt (Tab-separated text file containing pre-calculated raw count data)
chr19_regions.bed (BED file containing the genomic regions of interest)
sample_info.txt (Tab-separated text file containing sample metadata and group assignments)
workflows.stages: 1. Load pre-calculated count data into a SummarizedExperiment object using loadCountData ;; 2. Apply Anscombe transformation using ansTransform ;; 3. Normalize transformed counts across samples using normalizeData ;; 4. Perform non-parametric statistical testing for differential binding using DBAnalyze
workflows.code:
sampleInfo <- read.table(system.file("extdata", "sample_info.txt", package="CSSQ",mustWork = TRUE),sep="\t",header=TRUE)
countData <- loadCountData(system.file("extdata", "sample_count_data.txt", package="CSSQ",mustWork = TRUE),system.file("extdata", "chr19_regions.bed", package="CSSQ"),sampleInfo)
ansCountData <- ansTransform(countData)
normInfo <- normalizeData(ansCountData,numClusters=4)
result <- DBAnalyze(normInfo,comparison=c("HSMM","HESC"))

workflows.name: differential_binding_pipeline_wrapper
workflows.intent: Run the complete preprocessing (counting/loading, transformation, and normalization) and differential binding analysis using the all-in-one wrapper function.
input: chr19_regions.bed (BED file containing the genomic regions of interest)
sample_info.txt (Tab-separated text file containing sample metadata and group assignments)
BAM files (ChIP-seq IP and Input control BAM files in the sample directory) OR sample_count_data.txt (Tab-separated text file containing pre-calculated raw count data)
workflows.stages: 1. Preprocess data in a single step using preprocessData ;; 2. Perform non-parametric statistical testing for differential binding using DBAnalyze
workflows.code:
processedData <- preprocessData(system.file("extdata", "chr19_regions.bed", package="CSSQ"),system.file("extdata", "sample_info.txt", package="CSSQ"),sampleDir = system.file("extdata", package="CSSQ"),numClusters=4,noNeg=TRUE,plotData=FALSE)
processedData <- preprocessData(system.file("extdata", "chr19_regions.bed", package="CSSQ"),system.file("extdata", "sample_info.txt", package="CSSQ"),inputCountData = system.file("extdata", "sample_count_data.txt", package="CSSQ",mustWork = TRUE),numClusters=4,noNeg=TRUE,plotData=FALSE)
result <- DBAnalyze(processedData,comparison=c("HSMM","HESC"))
